nom: Peach Slices Redness Relief Soothing Cleanser

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split, with one reporting no help for redness or oiliness and another (also with rosacea) calling it perfection for oily sensitive skin.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers frequently report tightness, flaking, and stripping, though a few with dry/sensitive skin say it calms without drying at all.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly report a good, non-heavy feel and mild redness relief, but some note it can be drying or trigger small breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous and largely positive, describing it as gentle, non-irritating and non-stripping, though a minority still report burning, dryness or breakouts.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying normal skin reports a glow effect with only occasional hormonal breakouts.
segments.mature: A reviewer nearing her thirties with acne-prone, increasingly dry skin found it gentle and non-breakout-causing despite slight stripping; another in her late 40s calls it perfect for her skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer nearing her thirties noted the cleanser did not cause irritation despite drier, aging skin; another reported fine lines becoming more noticeable after use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report tightness, flaking and stripping after use, while others with similarly dry skin say it left skin hydrated and never tight.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including many with rosacea, report visible reduction in redness, often after days to weeks of consistent use; a notable minority (several rosacea sufferers included) say it did nothing for their redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe worsened irritation, stinging, burning or a raw feeling, sometimes after repeat use, while many more describe calmed, non-irritated, non-stripped skin.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers with rosacea or general redness on cheeks/forehead specifically report those spots fading or diminishing with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers report no new breakouts and even reduced acne bumps, but others—particularly those with oily or acne-prone skin—report new breakouts, including unusual zits and cystic-like bumps.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer specifically addressed oily skin and reported no improvement in oil control alongside no redness improvement.

extraits.texte: I bought this to specifically help with my redness due to rosacea, and my very oily skin. I did not notice a decrease in either of my concerns. I ended up returning it, and I am still on the search for my holy grail. 🙁 This product did not help me, but it may help you. And with Ulta's great return policy it makes the decision to try a new product an easy one.
I have used this for a month and my skin has gotten inflamed,dry,patchy, raw/sting/itchy painful/stiff feeling,breakouts and purple/red tone on everywhere but my forehead.

extraits.titre: Not for Oily or Acne Prone Skin Types
extraits.texte: It took me a while to accept that this cleanser with gentle ingredients was breaking me out. I love the Peach and Lily Glass skincare line and it never breaks me out, but this product seems aimed at drier skin types. This was ineffective at reducing my redness and i wouldnt recommend it for oily or acne prone skin types. It's gentle but i suspect the coconut-derived ingredients were clogging my pores bc i was getting zits in places unusual for me such as under my eyes and under my eyebrows. After i stopped using this, my skin immediately stopped breaking out in zits. Disappointed tbh:/

I have sensitive acne-prone skin that is getting drier as I'm nearing my thirties- I've tried lots of cleansers and this is good! I use this as my second cleanse after I use an oil-to-milk first cleanse to get sunscreen off. I switched over to this as my second cleanser after Ulta stopped carrying my holy grail AHA cleanser from another brand and it's been surprisingly good. It's not as hydrating as my holy grail and it can be a little stripping, but it doesn't break me out or cause irritation so that is a win in my book. The only thing to get used to is a lot comes out of the bottle because it is pretty watery, so you have to watch out for that. Please don't stop carrying this, Ulta!

I have extremely sensitive skin and struggle with eczema flair ups around my face and eyes. I bought this during my worst flair up. This, with the matching moisturizer, single handedly soothed and balanced my skin back to normal. Its so gentle, but leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling dry or stripped. Some cleansers in the past have felt painful to use on my eczema, but this never has. I have tried to switch up my skincare in the past due to boredom; but, everytime I will get a flair up and the first time I go back to this line, it resets my skin. I can't recommend this product more.

I love this cleanser so much, I'll probably never use anything else. I have Post-Inflammatory Erythema along with very dry skin and I started using this cleanser and the matching calming cream and it has calmed my redness down so much! It has a more watery consistency which I was a little hesitant about at first but with skincare you really don't need to use that much. Just enough to create a good lather. At night I use a cleansing balm to take off my makeup before using this cleanser so that it really targets my skin and I love it! I see a lot of people saying they don't like the consistency or that it didn't work but I've found this is one of those products that does take a couple of weeks to produce results and consistent use helps redness a lot!

Love this stuff! I've using two other popular gentle cleansers but they did not have additional redness relief ingredients. This one is something special — I really can feel that it's calming. Doesnt dry out my mild rosacea, sensitive, normal/dry, acne prone skin. A little goes a long way! You do not need a lot for this cleanser to foam. Will buy again today!
